versions.content: SwComponentType requiring access to shared calibration parameters needs RPortPrototype typed by a ParameterInterface Every SwComponentType requiring access to shared calibration parameters will have an RPortPrototype typed by a ParameterInterface . The definition of this shared calibration access in the context of a CompositionSwComponentType will be defined by creating a SwConnector between the relevant SwComponentPrototype s.
